_comment: Trace-measured speeds (spike40 traces at 51cf560, T4): OLS of latency_s on n_output_tokens per config (prefill_s = intercept, decode_tok_s = 1/slope), see reports/spike_diagnosis.md. The traces carry no separate prefill/decode timings, so the intercept also holds fixed per-call overhead; n_input_tokens is near-constant within a config, so prefill cannot be regressed out separately.
n_out_basis: reports/output_format.md compact gold tokens/page on train pages: mean and p99 (p95 is not published for the compact format; p99 is the upper bound used)
n_out_keyed_basis: reports/token_budget.md json-format gold tokens/page on train pages (keyed output format): mean and p99 (the upper bound), same tokenizers as the compact figures
t4_cu_source: observed by third party (mccormickml.com, checked 2026-03-10); not officially published by Google
t4_cu_per_hour_note: Colab compute units per T4 hour. Neither rate is published by Google and Colab can change it; check Runtime -> Manage sessions / Resources in the notebook UI for the real balance. Rates are for T4 only.
model_load_s_label: ESTIMATE: not measured. Seconds per model load (weights from the HF cache or download plus move to GPU), charged once per config run and once per smoke run.
